turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly, bags under the desk. Today we do subtraction. Fifty two minus twenty seven. Do it in your copy.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote 35? No, no. That is wrong. Arjun, you tell. Not 35. Next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Listen. Two is small, so take one ten. Twelve minus seven is five. Four minus two is two. Answer is twenty five. Everybody say, fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, again you wrote 35? I told you! Take one ten, twelve minus seven is five, four minus two is two. TAKE ONE TEN. Twelve minus seven. Four minus two. Understood?
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Okay, all of you understood? Thumbs up if you understood. Mina, thumbs up. Good.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now next sum. Forty three minus eighteen. Everybody do quickly, then show me copy.
turns.label: new_sum
